most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 matches the target's most distinctive motif—a primordial being who regurgitates/vomits up the earth and celestial bodies, then produces the world's animals and landscape features and finally gives humanity light and fire before the world settles into its present form.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 6 is a dynastic heroic epic of bow-contests, exile, and abduction with no cosmogony, no origin of animals or celestial bodies, and no creator figure withdrawing from a finished world.
